title: Queen Nzinga resists Portugal
summary: Nzinga ruled Ndongo and, from 1631, Matamba. Allied with the Imbangala and the Dutch, she fought Portugal until a 1656 treaty. She sold captives to the Dutch, by a 1643 report up to 13,000 a year, to fund her wars.
why: A woman ruler who resisted a European colonial power for decades while herself profiting from the slave trade.

notes.problem: Hero framing omitted that she sold captives to the Dutch (reportedly up to 13,000 a year) and used slave-trade profits to fund her wars.
